clinical_note_en: Get enough sleep. Allergies may be a cause of dark circles, so treat any allergies you have. Follow a balanced diet rich in minerals and vitamins while drinking enough water, reducing salt in food, and reducing stress and anxiety in your life. Useful home remedies: cold compresses (chilled tea bags or ice cubes wrapped in a cloth, or a spoon chilled in the refrigerator) on closed eyes for 10-15 minutes (the tannin in tea reduces under-eye swelling and evens out skin tone). Cucumber slices on the eyes for 10-15 minutes. Lemon juice with tomato wiped under the eye area. Almond oil and coconut oil applied to the dark circle area and left for 20 minutes. Almonds soaked in milk overnight, then ground and applied to the dark circles once daily for 10 days.
